title: Positioned anchor reset shrinking
description: Genuine current-upstream anchor mismatch; tagged arena entities only. This is console state parity, not current-source RCON.

steps.command: execute if entity @e[type=minecraft:armor_stand,tag=pp_shrink_src] run scoreboard players set #source pp_shrink 1
execute as @e[tag=pp_shrink_src,limit=1] at @s anchored eyes positioned ~ ~ ~ run summon minecraft:marker ^ ^ ^ {Tags:["pp_shrink_marker"]}
execute if entity @e[type=minecraft:marker,tag=pp_shrink_marker,x=2,y=64,z=2,dx=0,dy=0,dz=0] run scoreboard players set #feet pp_shrink 1

notes: Known positioned-anchor regression on upstream 5b53f064; fixed by source commit f123eb8. Terminal execute-if-entity is unsupported there, so entity conditions write scoreboard values observed by terminal score predicates. Setup and reset remain fixed during shrinking.
